shots.text: At Elderhollow Mother Briar fell, and the thorns that had grown through her went brown and crumbled. For forty years she had healed the Deepwood. Two years ago she went east to the Rift, like Ashwick, like Vholt. Before she died, the grey went out of her eyes.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The thicket-woman falling among the roots, grey flowers wilting, black thorns crumbling to brown.

shots.text:
The Marshal sent us to the Rift. Six of us. Study the Gate, he said...

He knew what was behind it.
shots.speaker: mother_briar
shots.art_note: Close on Mother Briar's face, the grey light leaving her eyes; for a moment she looks like herself, an old woman with healer's hands.

shots.text: Cassivane was my Marshal and my friend. I did not believe her. I thought it was the madness talking.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Ysolde in the Hall of the Ring reading a messenger's report, then folding it away.

shots.text: In the root-halls we found Sylvaine Thornwhisper, the Deepwood's best archer. She had held the root-doors alone while the whole town climbed out.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Sylvaine Thornwhisper standing amid a ring of fallen thorn-creatures and a felled walking oak, a pale leafing longbow in her hands, moss cloak. She lowers the bow.

shots.text: They're all out. Every child. Now show me where to stand.
shots.speaker: sylvaine
shots.art_note: Sylvaine at the edge of a tower platform, arrow on the string. Joins as a hero.
